title: Are you starving your spirit while feeding every other appetite?
paragraphs: Are you starving your spirit while feeding every other appetite?

We scroll for hours.
We binge opinions.
We consume noise like it’s nourishment.
But Jesus said, “Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God.” — Matthew 4:4

That means a full stomach can still hide an empty soul.
A busy life can still be spiritually malnourished.
A smiling face can still cover a starving faith.

Faith does not grow by accident.
It must be fed.

Not with hype.
Not with vibes.
Not with borrowed convictions from someone else’s sermon clip.
It is fed by the Word of God.

When temptation hits, Jesus did not fight Satan with feelings.
He fought with Scripture.
Not because He was weak.
Because He was showing us where real strength comes from.
Some of us are trying to survive spiritual battles on snack-sized devotion and leftover Sunday faith.

No wonder we feel dry.
No wonder we fold so quickly.
No wonder anxiety gets loud when truth gets quiet.

Jesus is not just telling you to read the Bible more.
He is calling you back to life.
Back to truth.
Back to the voice that heals what sin, fear, and shame have been feeding.

Feed your faith, and your flesh stops leading.
Feed your faith, and your mind starts clearing.
Feed your faith, and Christ becomes bigger than the craving, the fear, the failure.

Open the Word.
Read it slow.
Chew on it.
Pray it back.
Live it out.
Because your soul was never designed to live on bread alone.
